title: Local cohomology calculation for a strictly perfect tensor
statement: Let X be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] [pqf-def-locnoeth], U an open, E an object of D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], and K a strictly perfect complex on the over-site of U [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Assume an isomorphism E|_U = Q(K) and specified termwise bounds [a,b] for K. Let G be a complex of O_X-modules with termwise bounds [c,d] and coherent terms [pqf-def-coherent]. For every integer i the restriction to the open subscheme U of H^i(E tensor^L Q(G)) [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits] is coherent, and is zero if i<a+c or b+d<i. Only this fixed U and fixed K are used; no global perfectness or compactness is assumed.

source.place: perfect.tex, label lemma-tensor-perfect (0DJQ), proof local calculation; coherent.tex, label lemma-coherent-abelian-Noetherian (01Y0)

proof.text: Transport K to P on the open subscheme by Modules.overEquiv U. The equivalence preserves zero objects and finite coproducts and identifies the units. Apply it to each finite-free retraction, then compose with the coproduct unit comparison. The retract equation follows from functoriality. The transported complex retains the specified bounds [a,b]. Each term is flat: install tensorClosed and apply the existing public ObjectProperty.flat_coproduct to copies of the unit, then ObjectProperty.flat_of_retract directly at the transported-term call site. No duplicate scheme-specific flat_retract helper is declared.

Apply bounded-above flat implies K-flat to P. Restrict G through the over functor followed by the equivalence, obtaining N. Restriction preserves its [c,d] bounds. Coherent restriction gives coherent terms on the open subscheme; overFunctorEquiv and isomorphism invariance identify these with the terms of N.

Choose the standard derived localization on the open subscheme, independently of the over-site localization universe. mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryFactors transport e to Q(P). Use the open-restriction derived-tensor comparison and the K-flat tensor comparison to identify restricted E tensor Q(G) with Q(Tot(P tensor N)). The exact-functor homology comparison and homologyFunctorFactors give the explicit isomorphism from the restriction of each global homology sheaf to the ordinary total homology.

Outside [a+c,b+d], for p+q=i either p lies outside [a,b] or q lies outside [c,d], by integer arithmetic. A tensor summand is zero by tensorLeft or tensorRight preserving zero objects. HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.hom_ext then makes the identity of the total term zero. The short-complex zero-middle-term homology lemma makes its homology zero.

Apply the coherent-total-term lemma to P and N. For the short complex in degree i, kernel closure makes its cycles coherent. The incoming differential factors through this kernel; cokernel closure makes the cokernel of this factorization coherent. ShortComplex.homologyIsoCokernelLift identifies that cokernel with homology. Transport the coherent and zero properties across the homology isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem strictPerfect_tensor_local_cohomology
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hK : IsStrictlyPerfect X U K)
    (e : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)
    (G : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (a b c d : ℤ)
    (hKb : ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (K.X n))
    (hGb : ∀ n : ℤ, n < c ∨ d < n → IsZero (G.X n))
    (hGcoherent : ∀ n : ℤ, RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace (G.X n)) :
    ∀ i : ℤ,
      (i < a + c ∨ b + d < i →
        IsZero ((Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj
              (E ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G)))) ∧
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent U.toScheme.toRingedSpace
        ((Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj
              (E ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G)))
